core_conclusion: Thermal noise strongly mixes exact cycle winding while a weaker stationary directed mean current remains statistically resolved through the largest sampled T*=0.70.

caption: Figure 6. Stationary thermal hierarchy from trajectory-level inference. (a) Mean lattice-coordinate currents after 60 burn cycles and 100 measured cycles with trajectory-level 95% intervals; open low-temperature markers use N=500 trajectories per T*, whereas filled T*=0.50-0.70 markers use pooled two-seed N=1000 estimates. (b) High-temperature Hotelling zero-current rejection ratio relative to the declared 95% threshold; this ratio is not interpreted as a thermal critical scale. (c) The negative-v cycle probability approaches one-half while the exact deterministic target-winding probability remains near 1% in the high-temperature band, with bootstrap intervals shown where available.
